# hostaria_offer (Data Source)

Une offre, par `id` ou `name` (`GET /v1/offers`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostaria_offer" "starter" {
  name = "Starter"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `billing_interval` (String)
- `cpu_cores` (Number)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `price` (Number)
- `ram` (Number)
- `storage` (Number)
